name: Dollphone Icon Pack
tagline: Cute icon pack that isn’t overly hyperactive
blurb: Dollphone is a kawaii pastel icon pack that is very cute, but isn’t too hyper.
description:
Dollphone is a kawaii pastel icon pack that is very cute, but isn’t too hyper. The icons avoid overly saturated or dark colors, and softly bulge out the "straight" lines away from the center for a plushie-like look.

Dollphone Icon Pack is a crystallization of years of passion for the “yurukawa” aesthetic.

There are also original smartphone wallpapers that harmonize with the icons! You can also view and download them on the website.
